title: How Deep the Father's Love for Us

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: How deep the Father's love for us
How vast beyond all measure
That He should give His only Son
To make a wretch His treasure

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: How great the pain of searing loss
The Father turns His face away

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: As wounds which mar the Chosen One
Bring many sons to glory

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Behold the Man upon a cross
My sin upon His shoulders

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Ashamed, I hear my mocking voice
Call out among the scoffers
It was my sin that held Him there
Until it was accomplished

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: His dying breath has brought me life
I know that it is finished

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: I will not boast in anything
No gifts, no power, no wisdom

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: But I will boast in Jesus Christ
His death and resurrection

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Why should I gain from His reward
I cannot give an answer
But this I know with all my heart

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: His wounds have paid my ransom
Why should I gain from His reward
I cannot give an answer

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: But this I know with all my heart
His wounds have paid my ransom

lines: Your wounds have paid my ransom
